source_row.rationale: Clear signage indicating the specific type of isolation precautions in place and the required PPE should be posted at the room entrance (visible before entry), ensuring all staff, visitors, and ancillary personnel are informed and can don appropriate PPE before entering, regardless of the specific precaution type (contact, droplet, or airborne).
source_row.source_detail: Transmission-based precautions: precaution signage/PPE instructions at point of entry under facility isolation protocol; reviewed 2026-08-14.
